title: Tests: trigger system unit + integration + cross-impl vectors
description: Tests for trigger system: (1) Rust unit tests for trigger matching, claim window lifecycle, priority resolution, edge cases (no claims, all pass, multiple claims same priority). (2) Python tests mirroring Rust. (3) Cross-implementation test vectors in tests/vectors/. (4) Adversarial tests: claim from non-eligible player, claim after window closed, double-claim.
close_reason: 13 Rust tests + 13 Python tests + cross-impl test vectors in triggers.json. All pass.
